Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning

Class AnnularPressureBuildup

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning.AnnularPressureBuildup
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AnnularPressureBuildup extends Object implements Serializable
Annular pressure build-up (APB) in a trapped, sealed well annulus.

The pressure increase follows from volume compatibility of the trapped fluid and the annulus:

V0 alpha dT - V0 kappa dP - V_bled = C dP + D + V_gas dP / (P0 + dP)

  • alpha, kappa: fluid thermal expansivity (1/K) and isothermal compressibility (1/bar), constants or from a NeqSim fluid by finite differences
  • C: annulus compliance from the Lame thick-wall radial displacement of the outer string (internal pressure dP) and the inner string (external pressure dP)
  • D: volume change that does not depend on the annular pressure: thermal expansion of the steel strings and the inner string ballooning from a tubing pressure change
  • V_gas: optional compressible cushion (ideal gas, isothermal) at initial pressure P0

The residual is monotone in dP and solved by bisection. The result can be exported as a WellIntegrityScreening.AnnulusReading for MAASP comparison. Limitations: uniform temperature change per annulus, no cement bond or formation compliance (outer string treated as free standing unless rigid boundaries are selected), no fluid leak-off, no gas dissolution. Validation is by closed-form hand calculations (rigid-annulus limit dP = alpha dT / kappa and the Lame compliance formula) only.

1.0
